rules: Exactly four qualification fixture classes are mandatory for every DD: positive, negative, recovery, adversarial.
The existing dd-machine-fixture-catalog negative/recovery seed remains authoritative input; this plan expands qualification coverage without superseding it.
Positive/recovery mechanics may return PASS_NONFINAL only inside a test harness using explicit synthetic qualification; such a test result is never an independent qualification receipt.
Adversarial cases must prove caller context cannot act as oracle and unverified, stale, unresolved or conflicting evidence cannot strengthen claims.
Execution evidence must bind source tree SHA, evaluator artifact SHA-256, fixture plan digest, test report digest and execution principal.
GitHub Actions are not an execution or qualification authority.

positive.purpose: trusted current evidence contains all required facts and DD positive oracle fact=true

negative.purpose: DD-specific seed failure from dd-machine-fixture-catalog; positive claim prohibited

recovery.purpose: negative condition is explicitly reconciled/requalified and trusted current evidence proves restored safe floor

adversarial.purpose: caller-context oracle injection, unresolved/stale/unverified evidence, or conflicting fact injection must not strengthen claim
